descriptionPlain:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.
But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.
 


We're looking for an Account Executive – Northeast to help grow our LiveAction Network Observability and AI-driven Network Intelligence business. In this role, you'll be responsible for driving new business, expanding strategic customer relationships, and consistently exceeding revenue targets across the Northeast territory.
The ideal candidate has a proven track record of enterprise sales success, excels at building executive-level relationships, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. You'll work closely with channel partners, Sales Engineering, Marketing, and cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes while growing market share.
What You'll Do:
Develop and execute territory and account strategies aligned with company objectives.
Drive the full enterprise sales cycle, including prospecting, qualification, solution development, negotiation, closing, and customer onboarding.
Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and executive stakeholders to drive long-term success.
Generate and close net-new business while expanding existing customer opportunities.
Partner with distributors and channel partners to accelerate pipeline generation and deal execution.
Collaborate with Channel Account Managers (CAMs) on joint selling initiatives to maximize regional growth.
Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline, and opportunity management within Salesforce.
Partner closely with Sales Engineering to develop solutions that address complex customer challenges and demonstrate LiveAction's value.
Collaborate with Marketing to refine messaging and positioning based on customer insights and market feedback.
Represent LiveAction at industry conferences, customer events, and trade shows.
What You'll Bring:
Experience selling into the Northeast territory, including New York, New Jersey, Delaware, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Vermont, and Maine.
Proven success using a consultative, solution-selling approach.
Five or more years of enterprise new business development and/or account management experience within the networking industry.
Demonstrated history of consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas and driving significant pipeline growth.
Strong hunter mentality with the ability to create, develop, and close new opportunities.
Experience engaging executive decision-makers, including CIOs, CISOs, and other senior business leaders.
Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and consultative selling skills.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional and virtual teams.
Outstanding communication and presentation skills, including experience using virtual selling tools.
Ability to prioritize and adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Experience positioning enterprise networking solutions to both customers and partners.
Understanding of enterprise buying cycles and complex strategic account management.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Willingness to travel approximately 50%.
Nice to Have:
Experience selling Riverbed, NETSCOUT, or other Network Performance Monitoring (NPM) solutions.
Experience selling network reporting, application performance monitoring, network observability, or network security solutions.
The annual salary range for this position is USD 260,000–300,000, this is made up from base plus commission. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications. This role is for an existing vacancy.

descriptionPlain:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.


As a Customer Success Manager, you serve a shared portfolio of customers alongside your teammates rather than owning a named list of your own. Any customer in the pool may be yours on any given day, and your job is to make that experience feel seamless to them.
This is a different craft from named account management. You work from a prioritized queue driven by health signals, product usage, support activity, and renewal proximity. You load context quickly, diagnose accurately, deliver value in a compressed number of touchpoints, and leave the account better documented than you found it so the next teammate can pick up exactly where you left off.
You are equally comfortable walking a network operations lead through a product capability and explaining business impact to a director. You thrive on variety and volume, and you take pride in doing high-quality work at pace.
Key Responsibilities
Shared Portfolio Coverage & Customer Engagement
Serve customers across a shared portfolio, working from a prioritized queue rather than a fixed account list.
Deliver proactive lifecycle touchpoints, including onboarding confirmation, adoption checkpoints, and structured pre-renewal reviews.
Respond to inbound customer needs within team coverage standards and see them through to resolution.
Build credibility quickly with new stakeholders, often without the benefit of an established relationship.
Be the voice of the customer internally, using the breadth of the pool to spot patterns a single account view would miss.
Product & Technical Enablement
Guide customers on best practices, implementation planning, and usage optimization.
Deliver product demonstrations to drive adoption and unlock new use cases.
Collaborate with Support and Product teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
Translate technical capability into business outcomes the customer cares about.
Value Realization at Scale
Execute standardized success plays consistently and well, adapting the message rather than rebuilding the motion.
Confirm that every customer you touch has clear, documented outcomes they are working toward.
Connect product adoption to tangible business results in every customer conversation.
Contribute improvements to the plays themselves based on what you see working in the field.
Retention, Risk & Renewal Readiness
Detect churn risk early through health signals, usage decline, support friction, and stakeholder change.
Run structured pre-renewal reviews and prepare a clear readiness picture for each upcoming renewal.
Hand off renewals to the Renewals CSM with complete context, including value delivered, open risks, stakeholder map, and expansion signals.
Identify cross-sell and up-sell opportunities and route them to Sales with the supporting evidence.
Operational Excellence
Maintain rigorous documentation so account context lives in the system rather than in individual memory. This is the foundation of the pooled model.
Keep data accurate and current in internal systems, including Totango and Salesforce.
Manage many concurrent customer conversations without letting commitments slip.
Contribute to team KPIs, including coverage, response time, adoption, health score, and retention.
What You Bring
2 to 4 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Technical Support, or a similar customer-facing role in B2B SaaS.
A balance of technical aptitude and business acumen. You can speak both languages. Exposure to networking, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, or infrastructure is an asset.
Comfort serving many customers at once and prioritizing by signal rather than by relationship history.
Excellent written communication. A significant share of pooled engagement happens asynchronously, and your writing carries the relationship.
Strong documentation habits and genuine discipline about leaving a clean trail for teammates.
Experience delivering demos and running structured customer conversations.
Familiarity with CS and CRM tooling, such as Totango or Salesforce.
A proactive mindset: driven, accountable, coachable, and naturally customer-obsessed.

This is a different craft from named account management. You work from a prioritized queue driven by health signals, product usage, support activity, and renewal proximity. You load context quickly, diagnose accurately, deliver value in a compressed number of touchpoints, and leave the account better documented than you found it so the next teammate can pick up exactly where you left off.
You are equally comfortable walking a network operations lead through a product capability and explaining business impact to a director. You thrive on variety and volume, and you take pride in doing high-quality work at pace.
Key Responsibilities
Shared Portfolio Coverage & Customer Engagement
Serve customers across a shared portfolio, working from a prioritized queue rather than a fixed account list.
Deliver proactive lifecycle touchpoints, including onboarding confirmation, adoption checkpoints, and structured pre-renewal reviews.
Respond to inbound customer needs within team coverage standards and see them through to resolution.
Build credibility quickly with new stakeholders, often without the benefit of an established relationship.
Be the voice of the customer internally, using the breadth of the pool to spot patterns a single account view would miss.
Product & Technical Enablement
Guide customers on best practices, implementation planning, and usage optimization.
Deliver product demonstrations to drive adoption and unlock new use cases.
Collaborate with Support and Product teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
Translate technical capability into business outcomes the customer cares about.
Value Realization at Scale
Execute standardized success plays consistently and well, adapting the message rather than rebuilding the motion.
Confirm that every customer you touch has clear, documented outcomes they are working toward.
Connect product adoption to tangible business results in every customer conversation.
Contribute improvements to the plays themselves based on what you see working in the field.
Retention, Risk & Renewal Readiness
Detect churn risk early through health signals, usage decline, support friction, and stakeholder change.
Run structured pre-renewal reviews and prepare a clear readiness picture for each upcoming renewal.
Hand off renewals to the Renewals CSM with complete context, including value delivered, open risks, stakeholder map, and expansion signals.
Identify cross-sell and up-sell opportunities and route them to Sales with the supporting evidence.
Operational Excellence
Maintain rigorous documentation so account context lives in the system rather than in individual memory. This is the foundation of the pooled model.
Keep data accurate and current in internal systems, including Totango and Salesforce.
Manage many concurrent customer conversations without letting commitments slip.
Contribute to team KPIs, including coverage, response time, adoption, health score, and retention.
What You Bring
2 to 4 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Technical Support, or a similar customer-facing role in B2B SaaS.
A balance of technical aptitude and business acumen. You can speak both languages. Exposure to networking, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, or infrastructure is an asset.
Comfort serving many customers at once and prioritizing by signal rather than by relationship history.
Excellent written communication. A significant share of pooled engagement happens asynchronously, and your writing carries the relationship.
Strong documentation habits and genuine discipline about leaving a clean trail for teammates.
Experience delivering demos and running structured customer conversations.
Familiarity with CS and CRM tooling, such as Totango or Salesforce.
A proactive mindset: driven, accountable, coachable, and naturally customer-obsessed.

descriptionPlain:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.

BlueCat is seeking a Development Lab Administrator to build and manage product lab environments and facilitate hands-on testing of our products and related solution stacks. The successful candidate brings their technical, business and customer service skills to the team, gathering and interpreting requirements from internal stakeholders to build our virtual lab and enable product testing and development. 
 
Job Duties:

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to define requirements which you will then plan and implement to deliver a working environment to lab users
• Deploy virtual machines to create various network topologies and scenarios
• Perform software installations, activation, and configuration
• Ensure the environment is updated by applying software patches and upgrades
• Develop strategies for improving our ability to simulate and test real-world conditions
• Collaborate with product leaders to document requested testing and formulate test plans
• Perform planned detailed product-level feature, capability, and functional testing and report on your results 
• Partner as needed with product management and other stakeholders on additional lab, software, and business activities as needed

Professional Qualifications:

• 3+ year’s experience in a related technical role such as IT support, customer support engineer, DevOps, or product management
• Experience operating VMware, configuring Windows and Linux systems
• Solid understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, packet capture, DNS and DHCP
• Technical degree or certifications (ex: Computer Science, Information Systems, Cisco, VMware, etc.)
• Willingness to collaborate within a global organization across time zones and cultures
• Effective research skills; ability to leverage AI to collect, organize and integrate results
• Able to provide writing samples that demonstrate the ability to effectively communicate complex, technical concepts

Personal Characteristics:

• Entrepreneurial mindset, can-do attitude, adaptable, and results driven
• Productive: able to work independently and is self-directed
• Organized and detail oriented, with an ability to manage concurrent projects
•  Team-oriented, open to professional discourse and feedback
• Curiosity to learn about our portfolio

descriptionPlain:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.


We're seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our growing team!


About the role:
You will help own the CI/CD pipelines, build tooling and test infrastructure that let us build, test, secure and ship enterprise software. Our products are delivered across virtual, cloud and hardware platforms, so the automation behind them is large and spans multiple environments. You will help keep it fast, reliable and reproducible. You'll learn much of our stack on the job, with support from the team.

What you'll do:
Maintain and extend Jenkins pipelines and shared libraries.
Support the migration of GitLab pipelines to Jenkins.
Build, package and test Python and Java applications as Docker images, using Gradle and Make-based builds.
Maintain Terraform and Ansible automation for test environments across cloud and on-prem platforms.
Support provisioning across virtualization platforms and supporting test infrastructure.
Support system, upgrade and performance test automation, including scheduling and environment allocation.
Run and tune security and static analysis scanning pipelines.
Monitor pipeline and test health and report on trends.
Improve pipeline speed, reliability and failure triage.

What we're looking for:

Required
3+ years in DevOps, release engineering or build/infrastructure engineering.
Hands-on CI/CD experience, ideally with Jenkins.
Hands-on experience with Docker, including building images and running containerized workloads.
Experience in Java or Python, including building, packaging and testing applications.
Linux administration and Bash scripting.
Familiarity with Git and GitLab workflows, including GitLab runners.
Familiarity with at least one cloud or virtualization platform (AWS, Azure, GCP or VMware).
Strong troubleshooting skills.

Nice to have (we'll help you learn)
Terraform and Ansible.
Gradle or Make-based builds.
Jenkins Groovy and shared libraries.
Hyper-V, KVM or bare-metal provisioning.
Security scanning tools.
Kubernetes.

Key competencies:
Ownership and reliability.
Automation-first mindset.
Curiosity and willingness to learn.
Clear written communication, including runbooks.

Success in the first year:
30 days: Understand the pipeline topology, release flow and provisioning stack.
90 days: Own a pipeline area and measurably reduce its failure rate or run time.
6 months: Deliver an infrastructure improvement end to end.
12 months: Be a go-to owner for CI/CD reliability.

If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.
 


We are seeking a strategic Director of Marketing Operations to serve as the operational and technology backbone of our Marketing organization. Reporting to the SVP, Revenue Operations within the Revenue Operations team, this role owns and continuously optimizes the marketing technology (Martech) stack and drives lead lifecycle management, campaign execution, and source attribution to fuel predictable, efficient pipeline generation and retention/expansion across Demand Generation and Customer Marketing. The role also ensures partner-sourced pipeline is accurately sourced, routed, and attributed, so we have a consistent, well-instrumented view across our direct and indirect go-to-market motions.

Responsibilities:
Own and continuously optimize the marketing technology (Martech) stack, including marketing automation, CRM integrations, attribution, data enrichment, lead routing, and partner portal systems, across Demand Generation and Customer Marketing, ensuring it is integrated, reliable, and built to scale
Own the Martech budget and vendor relationships including selection, contracts, renewals, and ROI accountability
Identify, pilot, and implement AI and automation opportunities across marketing and indirect channel programs to improve efficiency, lead quality, and speed of execution
Build and maintain a source attribution model that accurately connects pipeline and revenue back to campaigns, channels, and partner activity
Own account and lead enrichment (e.g., ZoomInfo) to power accurate scoring, segmentation, and routing
Own lead lifecycle management and routing, including partner-sourced and partner-referred leads, ensuring speed-to-lead and clean hand-offs between Marketing, Channel, and Sales
Partner closely with Marketing leadership across Demand Generation and Customer Marketing to plan and execute campaign operations, from setup and segmentation through funnel measurement, and ensure systems and processes support their strategy
Own data governance and hygiene across the Martech stack, including field mapping, deduplication, and consent/compliance (e.g., GDPR), to protect data integrity across systems
Establish and enforce shared definitions and standards (e.g., MQL, SQL, funnel stages) across Marketing and Sales, partnering with the Analytics team to build and maintain the reporting and dashboards that track them
Own Sales–Marketing alignment on definitions, SLAs, and lead hand-off processes
Own source tracking, lead routing, and attribution for the indirect channel, including partner portal integration and partner lead flow
Ensure alignment and consistent measurement across direct and indirect (partner) go-to-market motions
Lead and develop the Marketing Operations team, building a scalable, high-performing operating function within Revenue Operations
Partner cross-functionally with Marketing (Demand Generation and Customer Marketing), Sales, Channel, Analytics, IT and Legal teams to evaluate, implement, and optimize Martech systems and integrations
Qualifications:
8–12+ years of experience in Marketing Operations or Martech roles in a B2B or SaaS environment
Deep, hands-on expertise with Marketo and Salesforce and a demonstrated track record of optimizing a Martech stack for scale and reliability
Experience identifying and implementing AI and automation solutions within marketing or RevOps systems (e.g., AI-driven lead scoring, workflow automation)
Preferred hands-on experience with ZoomInfo, LeanData, and Impartner (or equivalent enrichment, routing, and partner portal platforms)
Proven experience owning multi-touch attribution and source tracking across demand generation, customer marketing, and channel programs
Strong background in account/lead enrichment, lead lifecycle management, lead scoring, and routing design
Experience owning data governance, hygiene, and compliance (e.g., GDPR, deduplication, field mapping) across marketing systems
Experience managing Martech budgets and vendor relationships, including contract negotiation and ROI tracking
Excellent partnership skills, with a track record of working closely with Marketing leadership to translate campaign strategy into scalable systems and processes
Experience supporting indirect channel and partner programs, including partner portals, partner lead routing, and source attribution, strongly preferred
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop cross-functional operations teams
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable recommendations
Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
This position offers a salary range of $170,000 - $205,000 USD per year plus participation in a discretionary bonus plan. Final compensation will be based on skills, experience, and qualifications.  The role is for an existing vacancy.

descriptionPlain:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.
But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.
 


We are growing our Customer Care team and we're looking for an Enterprise Support Engineer to join our dynamic and customer-focused department.
 
Here is what you need to know about our Customer Care team: We are a technologically savvy and proactive team dedicated to outstanding customer experience. We love problem solving and we take pride in being the face of BlueCat for our customers. We enjoy and thrive off of receiving feedback and having the opportunity to voice the needs of our customers to the overall organization. Think of us as BlueCat’s front line warriors!
 
As an Enterprise Support Engineer (ESE), you will work directly with dedicated strategic enterprise customers to anticipate, identify and address their technical concerns.
 
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges. You will:
- Partner with dedicated clients and help them optimize the use of BlueCat products and services by understanding the customer’s request thoroughly combined with in-depth technical knowledge
- Perform quarterly Health Checks to ensure system performance.
- Become the ‘trusted advisor’ with dedicated customers, ensuring that recommendations are heard by the appropriate customer contacts and taken seriously
- Continually develop skills to manage BlueCat’s technology portfolio.
- Apply in-depth troubleshooting and debugging skills along with your knowledge of systems, databases, and applications to get to root cause of the customer’s issue.
- Set up test environments to mirror the customer’s production set-up and perform tests using customer’s data or representative data.
- Apply testing methodology and debugging skills to narrow down the problem as needed.
- Open support tickets with Engineering and provide steps to reproduce to solve customer issues.
- Partner with customers to determine their needs and recommend appropriate solutions.
- Ensuring customer issues are escalated to the appropriate teams are engaged (e.g. Sales, Professional Services, Engineering, Product Management, etc.)
- Provide after-hours support on a rotating schedule to ensure consistent support to customers when they need it.
- Validate and test upgrades in our lab, develop procedures, and assist customers during maintenance windows.
 
 
What will you bring to the team?
- You have an insatiable thirst for knowledge and improvement and the desire to grow in your role and with the company
- You are proactive; a tenacious self-starter to the core
- You are technically savvy with a deep knowledge of networking protocols and experience in debugging network issues (packet capture and analysis, etc.)
- You have strong experience with common protocols and services (FTP, TFTP, NTP, SNMP, syslog, etc.) and a thorough understanding of DNS, DHCP & Linux with 5+ years’ experience
- You are an excellent communicator - you have a way with words & can connect easily with others. You possess a strong ability to explain highly technical issues to non-technical audiences
- You have a passion for constant improvement - always looking to do things better (both personally, as part of a team and for the company)
- You are capable of prioritizing and allocating resources to / focus efficiently on multiple projects
- You have experience managing customers in an enterprise environment and can demonstrate excellence in customer service
- Providing detailed updates in customer cases that show progress to closure.
- The ability to maintain composure during high severity issues with a focus on getting to resolution.
The annual salary range for this position is USD 95,000–115,000, plus participation in a discretionary bonus plan. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications. This role is for an existing vacancy.

BlueCat is looking for a high-performing Federal Enterprise Account Executive to help expand our presence across key U.S. Federal agencies.
We are looking for a true enterprise seller — someone who can create opportunity, build executive relationships, navigate complex Federal environments, and close strategic deals.
This role is ideal for a motivated hunter who understands how Federal agencies buy technology and who can position BlueCat’s platform as a critical component of secure, resilient, and observable network infrastructure.
BlueCat helps organizations modernize mission-critical network services through:
DNS, DHCP, and IP Address Management (DDI)
Network Security and Zero Trust enablement
Infrastructure Automation
Hybrid Cloud Networking
Network Observability and Visibility
Federal agencies increasingly require operational visibility, resiliency, and automation across complex distributed environments. BlueCat provides the foundational intelligence and control needed to support those initiatives.

What You’ll Do:
Drive Territory Growth
Own a targeted set of Federal accounts and develop strategic territory plans focused on pipeline creation and revenue growth.
Prospect, qualify, and close opportunities across both existing and net-new Federal accounts.
Build multi-threaded relationships across technical, operational, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
Create momentum within strategic agencies through disciplined account planning and consistent customer engagement.
Lead Complex Sales Cycles
Manage sophisticated enterprise sales motions from discovery through close.
Understand customer environments, modernization priorities, funding paths, procurement models, and competitive landscapes.
Navigate Federal acquisition processes and partner-led procurement motions effectively.
Build strong business cases aligned to mission outcomes, resiliency, cybersecurity, and operational efficiency.
Position BlueCat’s Platform Value
Communicate BlueCat’s value across networking, cybersecurity, automation, cloud transformation, and network observability initiatives.
Help customers understand how foundational network intelligence improves visibility, resiliency, security posture, and operational control.
Partner closely with Sales Engineering to align technical solutions with agency priorities.
Collaborate Across Teams
Work closely with Channel, Marketing, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to accelerate pipeline and drive successful outcomes.
Build relationships with Federal integrators, resellers, and ecosystem partners.
Maintain accurate forecasting, opportunity management, and territory visibility within Salesforce.

What You Bring:
5+ years of enterprise technology sales experience within the U.S. Federal market.
Proven track record of exceeding quota and driving consistent pipeline growth.
Experience selling into Federal civilian, defense, or intelligence-related organizations.
Understanding of Federal procurement processes, contract vehicles, and partner ecosystems.
Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.
Strong prospecting, territory planning, and account development skills.
Executive presence with excellent communication and presentation abilities.
Ability to thrive in a high-growth environment where initiative and accountability matter.
Experience with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and modern sales engagement tools.

Preferred Experience:
Cybersecurity, networking, observability, infrastructure, SaaS, or automation sales experience.
Relationships within strategic Federal agencies or Federal systems integrators.
Experience working within high-growth or category-creating technology companies.
Familiarity with:
DNS / DDIZero Trust architecturesNetwork automationHybrid cloud networkingNetwork observability platformsInfrastructure visibility and telemetry

Why BlueCat:
Modern enterprises and Federal agencies increasingly depend on network intelligence to support cybersecurity, resiliency, and operational awareness.
BlueCat provides the foundational platform that enables organizations to modernize securely while improving visibility and control across complex environments.
This is an opportunity to join a company with:
Strong enterprise traction
A differentiated platform story
Expanding relevance in observability and cybersecurity
Significant growth opportunity across the Federal market
A collaborative, high-performance culture
If you are motivated by building relationships, winning strategic deals, and helping customers solve complex infrastructure challenges, we’d love to meet you.
The annual salary range for this position is USD 260,000–300,000, this is made up from base plus commission. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications. This role is for an existing vacancy.

We are looking for a true enterprise seller — someone who can create opportunity, build executive relationships, navigate complex Federal environments, and close strategic deals.

This role is ideal for a motivated hunter who understands how Federal agencies buy technology and who can position BlueCat’s platform as a critical component of secure, resilient, and observable network infrastructure.

BlueCat helps organizations modernize mission-critical network services through:

  • DNS, DHCP, and IP Address Management (DDI)
  • Network Security and Zero Trust enablement
  • Infrastructure Automation
  • Hybrid Cloud Networking
  • Network Observability and Visibility

Federal agencies increasingly require operational visibility, resiliency, and automation across complex distributed environments. BlueCat provides the foundational intelligence and control needed to support those initiatives.

What You’ll Do:

Drive Territory Growth

  • Own a targeted set of Federal accounts and develop strategic territory plans focused on pipeline creation and revenue growth.
  • Prospect, qualify, and close opportunities across both existing and net-new Federal accounts.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships across technical, operational, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
  • Create momentum within strategic agencies through disciplined account planning and consistent customer engagement.

Lead Complex Sales Cycles

  • Manage sophisticated enterprise sales motions from discovery through close.
  • Understand customer environments, modernization priorities, funding paths, procurement models, and competitive landscapes.
  • Navigate Federal acquisition processes and partner-led procurement motions effectively.
  • Build strong business cases aligned to mission outcomes, resiliency, cybersecurity, and operational efficiency.

Position BlueCat’s Platform Value

  • Communicate BlueCat’s value across networking, cybersecurity, automation, cloud transformation, and network observability initiatives.
  • Help customers understand how foundational network intelligence improves visibility, resiliency, security posture, and operational control.
  • Partner closely with Sales Engineering to align technical solutions with agency priorities.

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Work closely with Channel, Marketing, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to accelerate pipeline and drive successful outcomes.
  • Build relationships with Federal integrators, resellers, and ecosystem partners.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, opportunity management, and territory visibility within Salesforce.

What You Bring:

  • 5+ years of enterprise technology sales experience within the U.S. Federal market.
  • Proven track record of exceeding quota and driving consistent pipeline growth.
  • Experience selling into Federal civilian, defense, or intelligence-related organizations.
  • Understanding of Federal procurement processes, contract vehicles, and partner ecosystems.
  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong prospecting, territory planning, and account development skills.
  • Executive presence with excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a high-growth environment where initiative and accountability matter.
  • Experience with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and modern sales engagement tools.

Preferred Experience:

  • Cybersecurity, networking, observability, infrastructure, SaaS, or automation sales experience.
  • Relationships within strategic Federal agencies or Federal systems integrators.
  • Experience working within high-growth or category-creating technology companies.
  • Familiarity with:
    • DNS / DDI
    • Zero Trust architectures
    • Network automation
    • Hybrid cloud networking
    • Network observability platforms
    • Infrastructure visibility and telemetry

Why BlueCat:

Modern enterprises and Federal agencies increasingly depend on network intelligence to support cybersecurity, resiliency, and operational awareness.

BlueCat provides the foundational platform that enables organizations to modernize securely while improving visibility and control across complex environments.

This is an opportunity to join a company with:

  • Strong enterprise traction
  • A differentiated platform story
  • Expanding relevance in observability and cybersecurity
  • Significant growth opportunity across the Federal market
  • A collaborative, high-performance culture

If you are motivated by building relationships, winning strategic deals, and helping customers solve complex infrastructure challenges, we’d love to meet you.

The annual salary range for this position is USD 260,000–300,000, this is made up from base plus commission. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications. This role is for an existing vacancy.

We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.
But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.
About the Sales Team
 
The BlueCat sales team is a group of intelligent and market-aware sales professionals who like to have fun and win together. We are a highly engaged team that loves bringing creative solutions to the table to help grow and transform our business. We know how to be competitive, learn, and continue to support each other and our customers.
Does the idea of being on the forefront of network, cloud, and security technology excite you? If so, read on!
The Role
We are looking for a hungry and experienced Global Vice President of Mid-Market Sales to build and lead our worldwide Mid-Market sales organization across North America, EMEA, and APAC. The Mid-Market segment is defined as customers under 10,000 employees or $5B in revenue. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for the global strategy, execution, and results of a segment that is central to BlueCat’s growth. We are looking for a true builder and a do-er who creates the model, designs the plan, and builds the activities and operating rhythm to deliver it, not someone who has only executed a plan handed to them.
You will lead through regional sales leaders and field teams, operating our Velocity Engine, a partner-first strategy, and an activity-driven sales model to deliver repeatable, scalable, and predictable growth. This position reports to BlueCat’s Chief Revenue Officer.
What You'll Own
Build the operating model and go-to-market plan, define the activities and cadences that drive results, and own the outcome end to end.
Lead and develop a global Mid-Market sales organization, managing regional sales leaders and their teams of Account Executives across North America, EMEA, and APAC.
Own the global Mid-Market ACV and bookings targets on an annual and quarterly basis, and deliver consistent attainment across all regions.
Run the Velocity Engine globally: drive a consistent, repeatable sales motion that increases pipeline velocity, shortens sales cycles, and improves conversion at every stage.
Execute a partner-first strategy: ensure Mid-Market business is sourced, influenced, and closed with BlueCat’s channel partners (including the BlueCatalyst Partner Program), and work closely with Worldwide Channel and Alliances to build joint business plans, grow partner-sourced pipeline, and register and win deals together.
Champion an activity-driven model: define, instrument, and inspect the daily and weekly behaviors (prospecting, territory and account planning, high-quality customer engagements) that lead to successful outcomes, and coach leaders to manage to those leading indicators.
Own global pipeline generation, pipeline management, system hygiene, and accurate forecasting; deliver reliable forecast calls to executive leadership.
Partner with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Sales Operations, Finance, and Product to align demand generation, enablement, and coverage models and to meet the rapidly expanding needs of the sales organization.
Design and evolve the global Mid-Market coverage model, territory structure, quota capacity, and compensation alignment to support new-logo acquisition, expansion, and migration plays (for example, competitive DDI migrations).
Play a key role in recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and developing sales leaders and sellers across regions; build a deep bench and a culture of coaching.
Drive and foster a fun, inclusive, and winning culture that reflects our culture code, and win as One with colleagues across the company.
Lead quarterly business reviews, performance reviews, and operating cadences globally, and report on performance, risks, and opportunities to the CRO and executive team.
 
Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Required
10+ years successfully selling enterprise software with a consistent track record of exceeding quota.
At least 5 years in sales leadership, including experience leading leaders and managing a multi-region or global team.
At least 2 years selling infrastructure solutions to IT buyers; background in networking, DNS/DDI, cloud, or security is a strong plus.
Proven success leading teams in high-performing, growing software sales organizations, including building or scaling a Mid-Market or Commercial segment.
Demonstrated “GM of the business” mindset and a hands-on builder’s track record: someone who has created the model, built the plan, and put the activities in place, not simply run an existing plan. Experience at a larger company is valued, but we want a do-er as well.
Experience selling into companies of roughly 2,000–10,000 employees or $1B–$5B in revenue.
Deep experience with partner-led and channel-first go-to-market models, including working with resellers, distributors, MSPs, and alliance partners across regions.
Experience implementing activity-based management, sales methodologies, and operating rhythms that improve pipeline velocity and forecast accuracy.
Experience landing new logos, developing territories, and expanding existing accounts in partnership with Customer Success.
Experience operating across multiple geographies and cultures; comfortable adapting playbooks to regional market dynamics.
Bachelor’s degree required.
 
Key Attributes
Exceptional oral and written communication skills and proven negotiation skills, with executive presence.
Passionate about the skill and career development of others and about leveraging teams to multiply success.
Takes pride in the daily process that leads to future success. Metrics driven.
Enthusiastic. Loves to win, but hates losing more.
Will break glass to delight customers and partners.
Loves to learn and grow.
Ability to travel frequently globally, including to partner, customer, and company events such as the Annual Sales Kick-off (SKO).
The base salary range for this position is $200,000-$225,000 USD, with additional commission opportunity. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications. This role is for an existing vacancy.
 
 
Why BlueCat
BlueCat offers a friendly and exciting culture, great benefits, and a range of career opportunities in Canada, the US, Iceland, and Europe. Your voice and ideas matter to everybody, including our leadership team. We are Great Place To Work certified in multiple countries, and we have fun while we do it.
If you share our enthusiasm for the future of our company and are eager to contribute to our vibrant workplace, we look forward to receiving your application!
 
This position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; tax advantaged accounts (HSA, FSA); annual Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA); a 401(k) with company matching; paid parental leave; vacation, personal, and wellness days; an annual learning and development budget. Eligible employees may also participate in the company's annual bonus program.
 
Join us in shaping the future of our organization, where your talent and dedication can truly thrive. We invite you to apply and become a valuable member of our team!
 
BlueCat is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We also take affirmative action to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all applicants, including minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities. BlueCat will not discriminate or retaliate against applicants who inquire about, disclose, or discuss their compensation or that of other applicants. 
 
BlueCat participates in the E-Verify program to confirm the employment eligibility of new hires based in the USA. The E-Verify process is completed in conjunction with the Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification on or before the first day of work. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates. For more information about E-Verify, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/employees.

Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.
But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.
About the Sales Team
 
The BlueCat sales team is a group of intelligent and market-aware sales professionals who like to have fun and win together. We are a highly engaged team that loves bringing creative solutions to the table to help grow and transform our business. We know how to be competitive, learn, and continue to support each other and our customers.
Does the idea of being on the forefront of network, cloud, and security technology excite you? If so, read on!
The Role
We are looking for a hungry and experienced Global Vice President of Mid-Market Sales to build and lead our worldwide Mid-Market sales organization across North America, EMEA, and APAC. The Mid-Market segment is defined as customers under 10,000 employees or $5B in revenue. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for the global strategy, execution, and results of a segment that is central to BlueCat’s growth. We are looking for a true builder and a do-er who creates the model, designs the plan, and builds the activities and operating rhythm to deliver it, not someone who has only executed a plan handed to them.
You will lead through regional sales leaders and field teams, operating our Velocity Engine, a partner-first strategy, and an activity-driven sales model to deliver repeatable, scalable, and predictable growth. This position reports to BlueCat’s Chief Revenue Officer.
What You'll Own
Build the operating model and go-to-market plan, define the activities and cadences that drive results, and own the outcome end to end.
Lead and develop a global Mid-Market sales organization, managing regional sales leaders and their teams of Account Executives across North America, EMEA, and APAC.
Own the global Mid-Market ACV and bookings targets on an annual and quarterly basis, and deliver consistent attainment across all regions.
Run the Velocity Engine globally: drive a consistent, repeatable sales motion that increases pipeline velocity, shortens sales cycles, and improves conversion at every stage.
Execute a partner-first strategy: ensure Mid-Market business is sourced, influenced, and closed with BlueCat’s channel partners (including the BlueCatalyst Partner Program), and work closely with Worldwide Channel and Alliances to build joint business plans, grow partner-sourced pipeline, and register and win deals together.
Champion an activity-driven model: define, instrument, and inspect the daily and weekly behaviors (prospecting, territory and account planning, high-quality customer engagements) that lead to successful outcomes, and coach leaders to manage to those leading indicators.
Own global pipeline generation, pipeline management, system hygiene, and accurate forecasting; deliver reliable forecast calls to executive leadership.
Partner with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Sales Operations, Finance, and Product to align demand generation, enablement, and coverage models and to meet the rapidly expanding needs of the sales organization.
Design and evolve the global Mid-Market coverage model, territory structure, quota capacity, and compensation alignment to support new-logo acquisition, expansion, and migration plays (for example, competitive DDI migrations).
Play a key role in recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and developing sales leaders and sellers across regions; build a deep bench and a culture of coaching.
Drive and foster a fun, inclusive, and winning culture that reflects our culture code, and win as One with colleagues across the company.
Lead quarterly business reviews, performance reviews, and operating cadences globally, and report on performance, risks, and opportunities to the CRO and executive team.
 
Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Required
10+ years successfully selling enterprise software with a consistent track record of exceeding quota.
At least 5 years in sales leadership, including experience leading leaders and managing a multi-region or global team.
At least 2 years selling infrastructure solutions to IT buyers; background in networking, DNS/DDI, cloud, or security is a strong plus.
Proven success leading teams in high-performing, growing software sales organizations, including building or scaling a Mid-Market or Commercial segment.
Demonstrated “GM of the business” mindset and a hands-on builder’s track record: someone who has created the model, built the plan, and put the activities in place, not simply run an existing plan. Experience at a larger company is valued, but we want a do-er as well.
Experience selling into companies of roughly 2,000–10,000 employees or $1B–$5B in revenue.
Deep experience with partner-led and channel-first go-to-market models, including working with resellers, distributors, MSPs, and alliance partners across regions.
Experience implementing activity-based management, sales methodologies, and operating rhythms that improve pipeline velocity and forecast accuracy.
Experience landing new logos, developing territories, and expanding existing accounts in partnership with Customer Success.
Experience operating across multiple geographies and cultures; comfortable adapting playbooks to regional market dynamics.
Bachelor’s degree required.
 
Key Attributes
Exceptional oral and written communication skills and proven negotiation skills, with executive presence.
Passionate about the skill and career development of others and about leveraging teams to multiply success.
Takes pride in the daily process that leads to future success. Metrics driven.
Enthusiastic. Loves to win, but hates losing more.
Will break glass to delight customers and partners.
Loves to learn and grow.
Ability to travel frequently globally, including to partner, customer, and company events such as the Annual Sales Kick-off (SKO).
The base salary range for this position is $200,000-$225,000 USD, with additional commission opportunity. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications. This role is for an existing vacancy.
 
 
Why BlueCat
BlueCat offers a friendly and exciting culture, great benefits, and a range of career opportunities in Canada, the US, Iceland, and Europe. Your voice and ideas matter to everybody, including our leadership team. We are Great Place To Work certified in multiple countries, and we have fun while we do it.
If you share our enthusiasm for the future of our company and are eager to contribute to our vibrant workplace, we look forward to receiving your application!
 
This position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; tax advantaged accounts (HSA, FSA); annual Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA); a 401(k) with company matching; paid parental leave; vacation, personal, and wellness days; an annual learning and development budget. Eligible employees may also participate in the company's annual bonus program.
 
Join us in shaping the future of our organization, where your talent and dedication can truly thrive. We invite you to apply and become a valuable member of our team!
 
BlueCat is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We also take affirmative action to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all applicants, including minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities. BlueCat will not discriminate or retaliate against applicants who inquire about, disclose, or discuss their compensation or that of other applicants. 
 
BlueCat participates in the E-Verify program to confirm the employment eligibility of new hires based in the USA. The E-Verify process is completed in conjunction with the Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification on or before the first day of work. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates. For more information about E-Verify, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/employees.

We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.
But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.
 


As Manager of our Pooled Customer Success team, you will lead a team of 4 to 7 Customer Success Managers who share collective ownership of a large portfolio of customers. Your mandate is to build a high performing team that delivers consistent, measurable value across many accounts without the a named one to one relationship.
This is a different discipline from named account management. Success here comes from designing repeatable plays, prioritizing the right customers at the right moment, maintaining clean account context so any CSM can pick up any customer, and holding the team to response and follow through standards that protect retention at volume.
You are both an operator and a hands on coach. You build the coverage system, you improve it every quarter, and you develop CSMs who can move quickly, diagnose accurately, and create value in a compressed number of touchpoints.
Key Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Talent Development
Lead, coach, and develop a team of 4 to 7 pooled CSMs supporting a shared customer portfolio.
Manage workload distribution, queue coverage, and capacity across the team so no customer segment goes unattended.
Conduct regular portfolio reviews, renewal and risk reviews, and performance check ins.
Coach CSMs on rapid discovery, efficient customer conversations, and getting to value in fewer, higher quality interactions.
Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Hire, onboard, and develop CSM talent suited to a fast moving, high volume environment.
Driving Measurable Customer Value at Scale
Operationalize our Customer Value Framework through standardized plays rather than bespoke plans.
Ensure every customer in the pool receives defined lifecycle coverage, including onboarding confirmation, adoption checkpoints, and a structured pre renewal review.
Establish clear value milestones and outcome criteria that apply consistently across the portfolio.
Ensure product adoption is connected to tangible business results in every customer facing interaction.
Monitor portfolio health signals and direct team effort toward the accounts where intervention changes the outcome.
 
Retention, Expansion & Growth Alignment
Own retention performance for the pooled portfolio, including renewal readiness and early risk detection.
Partner closely with Renewals and Sales leadership on renewal strategy and expansion routing.
Ensure CSMs surface new use cases, new stakeholders, and expansion signals and hand them off cleanly.
Influence retention strategy through data driven insights and repeatable risk mitigation plays.
Operational Excellence & Scalability
Define and enforce the operating rhythm for the pool, including coverage standards, response expectations, escalation paths, and handoff protocols.
Ensure documentation discipline so that account context lives in the system, not in individual memory, and any CSM can serve any customer.
Ensure CRM and CS tooling reflect accurate account health, engagement history, and renewal status.
Use metrics such as coverage rate, time to first response, adoption, health scores, renewal rates, and expansion ARR to drive performance conversations.
Identify automation and process improvements that increase capacity without increasing headcount.
Cross Functional Leadership
Serve as the voice of a large and diverse customer population internally while balancing business priorities.
Partner with Support, Product, Professional Services, Renewals, and Sales to improve the customer journey for customers who do not have a dedicated resource.
Surface systemic risks, adoption blockers, and product feedback trends to senior leadership, using the volume of the pool as an early warning system for the broader base.
Contribute to strategic planning for the broader Customer Success organization.
What You Bring
5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, including:
3+ years in Customer Success or account management
2+ years managing or leading CSM teams
Experience operating a pooled, shared, or scaled coverage model, or a demonstrated ability to build one.
Strong understanding of renewal strategy, retention management, and risk identification at volume.
Proven ability to design and improve repeatable plays, playbooks, and operating standards.
Comfort managing through systems and data rather than through individual account relationships.
Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to translate portfolio signals into prioritized team action.
A leadership style grounded in transparency, ownership, and high standards.
This position offers a salary range of $125,000 - $155,000 USD per year plus participation in a discretionary bonus plan. Final compensation will be based on skills, experience, and qualifications.  The role is for an existing vacancy.

descriptionPlain:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.


As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive pipeline generation within a defined geographic territory that includes the DACH region (Germany, Austria and Switzerland). You will engage prospects in German and English.

This is a quality-driven role. You will engage inbound interest, run strategic outbound outreach, lead thoughtful discovery conversations and build well-qualified opportunities that are positioned to advance. You will work closely with Account Executives to ensure early-stage alignment and momentum.
Once an opportunity is created, the Account Executive takes ownership. You stay engaged to support momentum and help re-engage customers when progress stalls. Success is measured by opportunity progression and pipeline impact, not activity volume.
What You’ll Do
•    Generate new pipeline across your assigned territory, including DACH
•    Engage inbound leads and run outbound outreach, prioritizing by strategic fit and potential impact
•    Lead discovery conversations in German and English with technical leaders (Infrastructure, Network, Security) and senior decisionmakers (Director, VP and C-level where appropriate)
•    Uncover business priorities, operational challenges and buying dynamics
•    Create well-qualified opportunities backed by defined business or technical drivers, identified decision makers, timeline signals and a clear next step
•    Hand off to the aligned Account Executive with strong context and documentation
•    Keep thorough, actionable notes in Salesforce, including discovery insights and agreed next steps
•    Monitor opportunity momentum and lead re-engagement when it stalls
•    Contribute to conversion rates and pipeline health in your region

What Success Looks Like
•    Consistent creation of high-quality opportunities
•    Strong conversion of your opportunities into later stages and continued advancement
•    Discovery documentation that lets Account Executives move fast
•    Disciplined CRM hygiene and proactive follow-through on stalled opportunities
What We’re Looking For
We want people who are building a long-term career in sales and thrive in a structured, collaborative environment.
Required
•    Business-fluent German (spoken and written) and business-fluent English. This role covers DACH, so German is a requirement
•    1+ years of experience in sales, business development or another customer-facing role
•    Right to work in the UK / Germany
Preferred
•    B2B technology experience
•    Exposure to infrastructure, cybersecurity, networking or SaaS
•    Experience working in a geographic territory model

You are
•    Comfortable engaging both technical professionals and executive leaders
•    Curious, and able to connect technical challenges to business impact
•    Thoughtful in how you qualify and document opportunities
•    Accountable for your territory
•    Coachable and motivated to keep improving
Why This Role Matters
Pipeline quality drives revenue predictability and sales velocity at BlueCat. You will shape how opportunities enter and progress through the sales cycle, directly influence territory performance, and gain exposure to a diverse range of organizations across the UK and DACH.
The SDR role is a launchpad. Strong performers can grow toward Senior SDR, Account Executive or other paths that match their interests and strengths.

With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.
 


Qualifications
Experience and proven track record in developing cohesive multi-channel integrated campaigns
Strong project management, organizational, and communication skills
Experience working in a metrics-driven culture to measure how marketing activities contribute to pipeline generation
Ability to manage multiple projects with intertwining deadlines while staying focused on the details
Experience working in a B2B software marketing team
Understanding of multiple sales channels (i.e. direct sales, channel partners, and alliance partners) preferred
Marketing automation experience required (i.e. Marketo, Pardot, Hubspot)
Content marketing and demo automation management experience preferred (i.e. Pathfactory, Consensus, Storylane)
Experience strategizing, writing, creating, and measuring email nurtures
Experience planning, project managing, and executing webinar programs (Zoom Webinar, Goldcast.io preferred)
Exhibit willingness and flexibility to work both independently as well as part of a team, experience working asynchronously
Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets
Impeccable eye for detail
Experience with marketing reporting, and attribution reporting preferred
Strong aptitude and/or passion for leveraging AI in day-to-day execution, planning, and reporting
 
Responsibilities
Strategize, execute, and optimize a data-driven demand generation campaign strategy to achieve sales goals for Network Observability globally
Develop and deploy integrated marketing campaigns, including crafting strategy, aligning internal team members, and keeping on-track with key deadlines
Plan and execute our demand gen webinar program for Network Observability, including overall communications with speakers, technical setup, promotion strategy, and scheduling dry-runs and live hosting
Develop and manage marketing strategy with consideration for multiple sales channels (i.e. direct sales, channel partners, and strategic partners)
Assist with tracking and execution of conferences and field events, and promotion to drive meetings and engagement at the event
Exemplify understanding of marketing attribution reporting and connecting activities to pipeline generation
Clone and QC programs and campaigns in marketing automation and CRM
Strategize and execute email nurtures and email invitations for events, new product introduction, and new offerings for Network Observability
Apply an experimentation mindset to marketing campaigns to drive, test, learn, and optimize
Work with marketers across our team and in our company to ensure proper messaging, timing, and execution of multi-channel campaigns
Develop regional approach to demand generation plans, aligned to regional marketing-sourced pipeline goals for Network Observability
Align with SDRs on results of marketing campaigns and activities, gain anecdotal feedback, and generate ideas for campaign optimizations
Provide ongoing reporting, campaign insights and pacing toward goal to stakeholders
Document processes in Confluence and Sharepoint Powerpoint for transparency, document project management in Monday
 
This position offers a salary range of $140,000 - $150,000 USD per year plus participation in a discretionary bonus plan. Final compensation will be based on skills, experience, and qualifications. The role is for an existing vacancy.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Legal Counsel based in Toronto with strong technology background to join our organization as a senior member of our Legal team, reporting to the Global General Counsel. Role is hybrid with flexibility between remote and in-office at our Toronto headquarters. 
Responsibilities:
• Own technology transactions end-to-end, such SaaS, software licensing, software development, technology partnerships and services engagements.
• Drive internal compliance initiatives on topics such as privacy, open source, marketing, export compliance and others. 
• Take a lead role in M&A, overseeing due diligence and driving post-acquisition integration.
• Advise on intellectual property, open source, data protection and similar topics.
• Manage legal entities across our global jurisdictions.
• Manage outside counsel relationships around the world.
 
Qualifications:
• Active member in good standing with Law Society of Ontario.
• 7+ years of relevant experience in a top-tier law firm or corporate legal department in SaaS/software.
• Extensive experience drafting and negotiating technology-related agreements, including software licenses, SaaS agreements, technology development contracts and partner agreements.
• Exceptional negotiation, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to support fast-paced sales and partner transactions and advise internal sales clients.
• Knowledge of data privacy requirements and experience with data protection agreements.

Role is hybrid with flexibility between remote and in-office at our Toronto headquarters. 

Responsibilities:

• Own technology transactions end-to-end, such SaaS, software licensing, software development, technology partnerships and services engagements.

• Drive internal compliance initiatives on topics such as privacy, open source, marketing, export compliance and others. 

• Take a lead role in M&A, overseeing due diligence and driving post-acquisition integration.

• Advise on intellectual property, open source, data protection and similar topics.

• Manage legal entities across our global jurisdictions.

• Manage outside counsel relationships around the world.

 

Qualifications:

• Active member in good standing with Law Society of Ontario.

• 7+ years of relevant experience in a top-tier law firm or corporate legal department in SaaS/software.

• Extensive experience drafting and negotiating technology-related agreements, including software licenses, SaaS agreements, technology development contracts and partner agreements.

• Exceptional negotiation, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to support fast-paced sales and partner transactions and advise internal sales clients.

• Knowledge of data privacy requirements and experience with data protection agreements.

This position offers a base salary range of $190,000 - $208,000 CAD per year plus participation in a discretionary bonus plan. Final compensation will be based on skills, experience, and qualifications. The role is for an existing vacancy.

descriptionPlain:
Have you heard of BlueCat? We’re one of those hidden gems that’s been disrupting the market as a key player in the rapidly growing space of Intelligent Network Operations. Organizations require a new model of network operations that links foundational core services with a deep, predictive understanding of network health and performance to improve change readiness. BlueCat’s Intelligent NetOps is a first-to-market combination of systems of understanding and change. BlueCat enables teams to enhance agility and mitigate risks from high rates of change with a unified management lifecycle, from provisioning to proactive troubleshooting and remediation.
 
At BlueCat, we take immense pride in our award-winning culture, an integral part of our identity. We are proud recipients of several prestigious accolades, including the "Great Place to Work" certification. By becoming a part of our team, you not only join a company at the forefront of technology but also become an integral member of Canada's top workplaces in various categories, including Technology, Today's Youth and Women, and Mental Health and Inclusion.
 
Key Responsibilities
Build and operate our data lake on a ClickHouse-centered architecture, including ingestion pipelines, data modeling, partitioning, and replication.
Develop and maintain data pipelines and event-driven services that move messages and data across the platform.
Implement data analytics jobs and APIs that expose data to product and application teams.
Partner with Application teams to understand requirements and recommend sound approaches to data design and access patterns.
Improve the performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency of data services. This includes measurable gains in latency, throughput, and availability.
Implement data protection, security, and privacy controls for data processed from the edge to the core.
Build with modern, asynchronous Python and Golang, and use other languages where they fit.
Write and maintain documentation, including designs, evaluation plans, test results, and technical manuals.
Qualifications
5+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years building data platforms or data-intensive distributed systems.
Hands-on experience with ClickHouse or a comparable OLAP database or query engine (DuckDB, Druid, Pinot, Trino, or similar). This includes data modeling, ingestion, and query performance tuning.
Experience with data lake architectures and open file and table formats such as Parquet and Apache Iceberg (Delta Lake is a plus), on object storage.
Strong production experience with Python (including async programming) and/or Golang.
Experience with data processing and analytics tools such as Pandas, Polars, DuckDB, or equivalents (Dask, Ray, Prefect are a plus).
Experience building data pipelines on messaging and streaming systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, or similar).
Passion for building solid REST APIs and distributed services.
Experience with cloud-native technologies: Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, and observability.
Experience with AWS (GCP and Azure are a plus).
Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S) and distributed systems design.
Working knowledge of the SDLC, Agile, testing strategies, and secure engineering practices.
Strong communication and teamwork skills.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Highly desirable: Kubernetes certification (CKAD or CKA).
This position offers a base salary range of $130,000 - $150,000 CAD per year plus participation in a discretionary bonus plan. Final compensation will be based on skills, experience, and qualifications. The role is for an existing vacancy.

•    3+ years professional experience in full stack development 
•    Proven expertise in asynchronous programming
•    Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, Angular, NodeJS

•    Experience working in AWS ecosystem
•    Basic Linux system administration
•    Clear and professional communication skills
•    Excellent knowledge of English language

•    Participate in code reviews and influence technical roadmap and architectural decisions.
•    Collaborate with product and platform teams to deliver resilient, secure, and observable services and applications.
•    Must be able to work independently and communicate effectively with coworkers across multiple time zones
•    Integrate open source and open standards reducing internal code generations and reaping the benefits of the open-source community.
•    Other ad hoc duties as required.
•    Obligation to carry out other job activities, as requested by the nature of the Employee’s position, and in line with the Employer’s instructions

If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.


About the Role
We are looking for a Software QA Specialist to join our Engineering Nexus – Integrity team.
You will work closely with software engineers to ensure the quality and reliability of our products through a combination of manual and automated testing. You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle — from understanding requirements and identifying risks to building automated tests, investigating defects, and continuously improving our testing practices.
Our products use modern test automation technologies, including Cypress and Playwright.

What You’ll Do
Design, develop, and execute manual and automated tests.
Build and maintain reliable automated test suites using the technologies adopted across our products.
Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
Test APIs and integrations as part of end-to-end product validation.
Identify, investigate, document, and track defects through resolution.
Collaborate with software engineers to improve testability and identify quality risks early.
Contribute to automated testing within CI/CD pipelines.
Help improve testing practices, automation frameworks, and overall product quality.
Share knowledge and provide guidance to less experienced QA team members.

What We’re Looking For
3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance or Software Testing.
Strong understanding of manual and automated testing methodologies.
Experience with modern web test automation frameworks.
Good programming or scripting skills, preferably JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
Experience with functional, regression, integration, and API testing.
Experience with Git or another version control system.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively within a cross-functional engineering team.
Proactive approach to quality and continuous improvement.

Nice to Have
Experience with Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, Robot or similar web automation technologies.
Experience with API test automation.
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with performance testing.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
