descriptionPlain:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.


About the role:
We're looking for a systems engineer to build and operate high-throughput, low-latency network infrastructure written in Rust. You'll work on the core data plane of a production DNS platform. This service that handles large query volumes with tight latency budgets, strong reliability guarantees. It's also a role where you stay close to the people who use what you build, translating real customer problems into the right technical solution.
What you'll do:
• Design and implement components of a high-performance DNS engine: resolvers, forwarders, caching layers, and request-processing pipelines.
• Implement and harden DNS protocol features across transports: UDP/TCP, DNS-over-HTTPS, DNS-over-TLS, DNSSEC, EDNS Client Subnet, and related standards.
• Build features for traffic management and reliability: global server load balancing, health-checking, policy evaluation, response rewriting, and threat/security filtering.
• Profile and optimize hot paths: memory allocation, data structures (tries, caches), connection pooling and multiplexing and back changes with benchmarks.
• Integrate the data plane with control-plane services: configuration updates across distributed deployed nodes.
• Own observability for your components: metrics, structured logging/tracing, and diagnostics that make production behavior legible.
• Write thorough unit, integration, and component tests; keep the build green and the codebase clean (linting, formatting, dependency hygiene, security advisories).
Working with customers and product
• Listen directly to customers: through support escalations, field reports, and conversations to understand the problem behind the request, not just the feature they asked for.
• Partner with product management to turn customer pain points into well-scoped features, and help shape the roadmap by grounding it in what's technically feasible and where the real leverage is.
• Reproduce and diagnose customer-reported issues in production traffic patterns, then design fixes that address the root cause rather than the symptom.
What we're looking for:
• Strong systems programming experience in Rust, including async programming with tokio
• Solid grasp of networking fundamentals: TCP/UDP, TLS, HTTP, and ideally DNS or another wire protocol.
• Experience writing performance-sensitive concurrent code, and the instinct to measure before and after with benchmarks and profiling.
• A test-first, correctness-oriented mindset — you care about edge cases, graceful shutdown, backpressure, and deterministic behavior under concurrency.
• Comfort working across a large workspace: crates/modules, shared libraries, plugin boundaries, and CI.
• Strong communication skills and genuine customer empathy: you can talk to non-engineers, ask the right questions, and translate fuzzy problems into concrete engineering work.
Nice to have:
• Open source work in the Rust/tokio ecosystem a major plus
• DNS internals (record types, SOA/TTL handling, DNSSEC, ECS, dnstap).
• Prometheus metrics, tracing, and production observability practices.
• Protobuf/gRPC, service discovery, and control-plane/data-plane architectures.
• Allocator tuning (jemalloc/mimalloc), lock-free/atomic programming, and low-level performance work.
• Experience upgrading language toolchains and managing dependency/security posture over time.
• Experience working directly with customers or in a product-partnered engineering role.
Impact:
Your work directly affects the performance, resilience, and security of a service that sits on the critical path for every request that depends on it. Small improvements in latency, memory, or correctness matter at scale, and because you stay close to customers, you'll see those improvements land as real problems solved.

About the role:
The DNS Resolver team develops and maintains one of BlueCat’s core DNS products for the BlueCat Horizon Platform: a high-performance DNS server written in Rust with integrations to AWS, Azure, and GCP, supported by cloud-based services for configuration and control. 
We are looking for a Technical Manager to lead a team of software developers ranging from junior through Staff level. This is a hands-on technical management role for someone who wants to stay close to the architecture and implementation while also taking responsibility for the growth of the engineers on the team.
Key Responsibilities:
You will lead the Resolver engineering team and work closely with Product Management, Release Management, and other engineering teams to plan and deliver new capabilities. You’ll be responsible for the mentorship, performance, and career development of your direct reports, helping them achieve their best while identifying and removing roadblocks for the team.
You will be expected to understand the systems the team owns well enough to participate meaningfully in architecture and design discussions, review technical approaches, help investigate difficult problems, and contribute to the codebase when appropriate. You will work closely with senior engineers on architectural direction while helping the team make sound technical decisions and maintain a high standard of engineering quality.
A major focus of the role will be the evolution of Resolver’s cloud management services and their migration onto the Horizon platform.
Responsibilities/Duties:
• Manage, mentor, and support the career development of software developers from junior through Staff level.
• Work with Product Management and Release Management to plan, scope, estimate, and deliver the team’s work.
• Participate in feature design and help translate product requirements into practical technical solutions.
• Work with senior engineers to guide architectural decisions and the evolution of Resolver and its supporting services.
• Maintain a strong focus on software quality, maintainability, performance, and sound architecture.
• Stay close to the implementation through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, and occasional code contributions.
• Help the team design and maintain performance-sensitive and concurrent software.
• Coordinate the technical investigation and triage of customer-reported issues, working with Customer Care and other teams as needed.
• Build strong working relationships across engineering, Product, Release Management, and other parts of BlueCat.
• Represent the Resolver team in cross-team discussions and make sure its technical needs, dependencies, and accomplishments are understood.
• Help the team balance delivery of new functionality with technical debt, reliability, and longer-term architectural improvements.

Qualifications:
• 7+ years of software development experience, ideally including work on systems, networking, distributed systems, or other performance-sensitive software.
• Experience managing software developers or providing substantial technical and people leadership.
• Strong software engineering background and the ability to participate credibly in architecture, design, code review, and technical problem-solving.
• Expertise with Rust, Java, or Go. Rust experience is strongly preferred.
• Expertise with Docker and containerized applications.
• Experience designing, building, or integrating REST APIs and backend services.
• Experience with concurrent, mission critical and performance-sensitive software.
• Strong understanding of computer networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP and HTTP/S.
• Experience with DNS is an asset but is not required.
• Experience working with Kubernetes or other cloud-native platforms.
• Experience with AWS is preferred; Azure or GCP experience is also useful.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Comfortable working with a team that includes both office-based and fully remote engineers.

descriptionBody:
About the role:

The DNS Resolver team develops and maintains one of BlueCat’s core DNS products for the BlueCat Horizon Platform: a high-performance DNS server written in Rust with integrations to AWS, Azure, and GCP, supported by cloud-based services for configuration and control. 

We are looking for a Technical Manager to lead a team of software developers ranging from junior through Staff level. This is a hands-on technical management role for someone who wants to stay close to the architecture and implementation while also taking responsibility for the growth of the engineers on the team.

Key Responsibilities:

You will lead the Resolver engineering team and work closely with Product Management, Release Management, and other engineering teams to plan and deliver new capabilities. You’ll be responsible for the mentorship, performance, and career development of your direct reports, helping them achieve their best while identifying and removing roadblocks for the team.
You will be expected to understand the systems the team owns well enough to participate meaningfully in architecture and design discussions, review technical approaches, help investigate difficult problems, and contribute to the codebase when appropriate. You will work closely with senior engineers on architectural direction while helping the team make sound technical decisions and maintain a high standard of engineering quality.
A major focus of the role will be the evolution of Resolver’s cloud management services and their migration onto the Horizon platform.

Responsibilities/Duties:

• Manage, mentor, and support the career development of software developers from junior through Staff level.
• Work with Product Management and Release Management to plan, scope, estimate, and deliver the team’s work.
• Participate in feature design and help translate product requirements into practical technical solutions.
• Work with senior engineers to guide architectural decisions and the evolution of Resolver and its supporting services.
• Maintain a strong focus on software quality, maintainability, performance, and sound architecture.
• Stay close to the implementation through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, and occasional code contributions.
• Help the team design and maintain performance-sensitive and concurrent software.
• Coordinate the technical investigation and triage of customer-reported issues, working with Customer Care and other teams as needed.
• Build strong working relationships across engineering, Product, Release Management, and other parts of BlueCat.
• Represent the Resolver team in cross-team discussions and make sure its technical needs, dependencies, and accomplishments are understood.
• Help the team balance delivery of new functionality with technical debt, reliability, and longer-term architectural improvements.

Qualifications:

• 7+ years of software development experience, ideally including work on systems, networking, distributed systems, or other performance-sensitive software.
• Experience managing software developers or providing substantial technical and people leadership.
• Strong software engineering background and the ability to participate credibly in architecture, design, code review, and technical problem-solving.
• Expertise with Rust, Java, or Go. Rust experience is strongly preferred.
• Expertise with Docker and containerized applications.
• Experience designing, building, or integrating REST APIs and backend services.
• Experience with concurrent, mission critical and performance-sensitive software.
• Strong understanding of computer networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP and HTTP/S.
• Experience with DNS is an asset but is not required.
• Experience working with Kubernetes or other cloud-native platforms.
• Experience with AWS is preferred; Azure or GCP experience is also useful.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Comfortable working with a team that includes both office-based and fully remote engineers.

descriptionPlain:
BlueCat and LiveAction offer complementary solutions to enhance network performance and security. LiveAction’s Network Intelligence platform transforms complex data into actionable insights, providing organizations with a comprehensive view of their network, from network and application performance to security. This enables enterprise teams to rapidly resolve network issues at scale, accelerate threat response, increase employee productivity, and reduce business risk. Meanwhile, BlueCat provides a suite of solutions that help network, security, applications, and cloud and DevOps teams optimize the IP environment, driving business outcomes forward. 

Together, these platforms empower organizations to maintain robust, efficient, and secure network operations.



Overview:
First line of support for customers facing technical issues with network monitoring and analysis.
Responsibilities
·        Manage Cases: Log all customer interactions and technical steps taken in SFDC.
·        ID Issues: Determine nature of the problem, ask clarifying questions and leveraging diagnostic tools.
·        Resolve Issues: Resolve common issues using KB articles, prior training, and testing in lab.
·        Create Tickets: If necessary, enter bugs and feature suggestions with supporting information.
·        Manage Escalation: Escalate unsolved issues to Tier 3 support with prerequisite information.
·        Communicate Continuously: Keep internal stakeholders and customers informed on issues.
·        Collect Feedback: Ensure feedback is documented and radiated to proper personnel.
·        Document: Add or updated KB articles to ensure we are improving efficiency.
 
Qualifications:
·        BS degree in science or equivalent work experience.
·        2 or more years previous experience in a technical support role.
·        Basic understanding of servers, networks, routers, and switches.
·        Knowledge of NetFlow, SNMP, Routing, LAN, IP SLA, QoS, SSH, and Telnet.
·        Ability to use diagnostic network issues using common debugging tools.
·        Basic understanding of security, virtualization, DBs, and Rest APIs.
·        Basic knowledge of operating systems (Windows and Linux).
·        Self-starter and detailed oriented.
 
Nice to have
·        Experience with Cloud AWS, Azure, and GCP
·        CCNA or equivalent certification

descriptionPlain:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.


BlueCat is seeking a VP, Engineering, Network Observability to lead the engineering organization behind LiveAction, BlueCat's Network Observability product line. This leader will own the technical direction, architecture, delivery, and operational excellence of a complex, data-intensive platform that gives enterprises, telcos, and government agencies deep, predictive visibility into network health, performance, and behavior — from the data center and campus to the WAN, cloud, and edge.
This is a highly cross-functional leadership role partnering closely with Product Management, Customer Care, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure tight alignment between engineering execution, customer experience, and business outcomes.
Experience
We are looking for someone who has experience:
Setting the technical direction and multi-year engineering roadmap for a network observability, network performance monitoring (NPM), or infrastructure monitoring product line
Leading engineering teams that have delivered successful enterprise infrastructure products and services, both SaaS and on-prem
Architecting and scaling data-intensive platforms that ingest, process, and analyze network telemetry — flow data (NetFlow/IPFIX/sFlow), SNMP, packet capture, synthetic testing, and streaming telemetry
Delivering AI (ML, Generative, Agentic) capabilities for anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and predictive insights that reduce mean-time-to-resolution
Evolving long-lived code bases and developing a pragmatic go-forward plan to retire tech debt
Building high-performing, geographically distributed engineering teams, including managing work transitions to offshore teams and multiple sites
Coaching, mentoring, and developing top talent, including managers and senior technical leaders
Establishing software development standards, processes, and best practices for the entire organization
Developing strategic plans to accomplish technical and business objectives with Product Management, executive leadership, and your team members
Engaging directly with enterprise and government strategic accounts to understand technical requirements and resolve escalations
Required Qualifications
MS/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields
15+ years of experience in a software engineering environment
10+ years managing senior individual contributors and other leads/managers, including leading managers of managers
Direct experience building network observability, network performance monitoring, or network/infrastructure management products
Strong technical fluency in networking fundamentals and telemetry (TCP/IP, routing/switching, NetFlow/IPFIX, SNMP, packet analysis, WAN/SD-WAN) and key open source technologies – e.g. clickhouse, Prometheus/Grafana, K8s
Experience in delivering high performance hardware/appliances system for network telemetry/packets. 
Strong experience and detailed technical knowledge in SaaS or PaaS engineering, as well as on-prem enterprise software delivery
Strong development experience in Java, C++, or similar OO languages
Experience operating at, or reporting directly to, the C-level
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Experience in a collaborative, agile development environment
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience developing services on a public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle)
Experience with high-throughput data pipelines and analytics (e.g., streaming, time-series, and large-scale storage technologies)
Background in AIOps, machine learning for anomaly detection, or predictive analytics applied to network or IT operations
Experience transitioning a product tech stack toward a more open-source, cloud-portable architecture
Familiarity with government/public sector requirements (e.g., FedRAMP, StateRAMP, ATO processes)
Post-acquisition technology integration experience
Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., sales engineering, professional services, support, product management)
A mix of smaller-company (<$100M revenue) and larger-company (>$1B revenue) experience
